_note: Locked ground-truth stance records, all labeled oppose, added 2026-11-28 to give the stance scorer more clear oppose cases: a tax increase (Jason Smith), a spending bill (DeLauro on the 2025 rescissions package), a specific regulation rollback (Pallone), Medicaid work requirements (Wyden), birthright citizenship (Babin) and a specific EPA rule (Capito). No politician-and-key pair here repeats one locked in a db/stance-ground-truth-*.json file. Every excerpt is quoted verbatim from a page the politician or the committee office they lead controls; fragments are separated by " ... ". Same record shape as db/stance-ground-truth-talarico-cost-of-living.json. Test coverage only: no live code reads this file (it is deliberately outside the stance-ground-truth-* name pattern the ingest-time locked-label index loads), it is not used to tune any rule, and it is scored by scripts/rescore-oppose-ground-truth-2026-11.mjs.

records.position_on: raising taxes on corporations and higher earners (the proposed 21% to 28% corporate rate increase and the broader Democratic tax-hike plans)
records.confidence_reason: Two of his own releases call the proposed tax increases dead on arrival and pledge to stop them, and the committee release names the corporate rate increase as the target; held at 0.8 because his framing is about taxes on everyone, so the link to the fairer-share key is through the corporate-rate proposal rather than a statement about the wealthy specifically.

sources.type: official committee press release (Ways and Means, chairman's statement)
sources.excerpt: "President Biden tonight plans to make clear he’s on the side of higher taxes and more corporate giveaways. These proposals will kill jobs, hurt families and small businesses, and put America at a disadvantage to Communist China. As we have said every time he has proposed these tax increases before, they are dead on arrival." ... "President Biden has frequently called to repeal the 2017 tax reform, including increasing the corporate tax rate from 21 percent to 28 percent"
sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-28. Released by the committee he chairs; the first fragment is his quoted statement, the second is the release's own background text naming the corporate rate increase. Published date from the page metadata.

sources.excerpt: "The last thing working-class Americans need is an unprecedented $7 trillion tax hike." ... "As Chairman of the Ways and Means Committee, I will continue working around the clock to stop the $7 trillion Biden-Harris tax hike."

records.position_on: rolling back a specific federal regulation (H.R. 7673, which would void DOE's laundry-machine energy efficiency standard and bar standards that raise upfront cost)
records.confidence_reason: His own floor remarks say he opposes the bill and urge colleagues to oppose it, and defend DOE's standard-setting process; held at 0.75 because the source is one floor statement on one appliance standard, not a statement on federal regulation in general.

"So I oppose this legislation because it will increase energy costs for American families and undermine our ongoing efforts to combat the worsening climate crisis." ... "I urge all my colleagues to oppose this bill, and I reserve the balance of my time."
